observations.controlled_result: No measured behavioral benefit from B2 on the three controlled old-vs-candidate scenarios; both versions passed. Candidate observed cost was slightly higher on each controlled scenario.
observations.weak_model_result: The secondary model initially treated bare continue as B2 authorization and later produced a malformed non-interactive tool call without writing files. Candidate wording removed the unauthorized write but did not guarantee a clean headless response.
observations.claim_limit: These results show observed fixture behavior, not reliability percentages or measured savings. Final adoption remains blocked on broader connected-feature evidence.
